svg.title: Reconcile $160,000 Gross Sales to $44,000 Owner Net
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-03-base-case-profit-waterfall; chart type: waterfall; title: Reconcile $160,000 Gross Sales to $44,000 Owner Net; subtitle: Six bars establish the Base-Case 27.5% annual net margin.; chapter number: 3; epistemic tag: illustrative_model; assumptions note: The canonical Base Case fixes gross revenue at $160,000 and annual owner net profit at $44,000. The four expense buckets below are an illustrative allocation of the required $116,000 total cost, not additional scorecard facts. Intermediate bars are signed deductions; the final bar is an absolute total.; caption: $160,000 - $60,000 - $12,000 - $24,000 - $20,000 = $44,000; $44,000 / $160,000 = 27.5%. Conservative: $20,000 at 15% yields $3,000 with 1 FT + 1 C. Scaled: $300,000 at 40% yields $120,000 with 2 FT + 2 C.; stages: label: Gross domain sale proceeds; value: $160,000 annual operator revenue; numeric value: 160000.0; detail: Start with completed domain sales before selling fees; do not substitute portfolio asking prices, third-party merchant volume, or escrow deposits.; label: Sold-domain acquisition basis; value: -$60,000 allocated purchase costs; numeric value: -60000.0; detail: Assign purchase prices and acquisition fees to the domains sold; unsold inventory purchases remain a separate cash-use and inventory schedule.; label: Portfolio renewals; value: -$12,000 annual carrying expense; numeric value: -12000.0; detail: Include current-period renewal charges across retained and sold inventory; remove any amounts already included in acquisition basis.; label: Selling and settlement costs; value: -$24,000 combined transaction expense; numeric value: -24000.0; detail: Assume a blended 15% of gross proceeds covering marketplace commissions and settlement charges; replace this model rate with actual venue invoices.; label: Other operating expense; value: -$20,000 annual operating budget; numeric value: -20000.0; detail: Budget contractor support, research tools, outreach, and administration at approximately $1,667 monthly; exclude renewals and transaction fees counted above.; label: Annual owner net profit; value: $44,000 retained operating result; numeric value: 44000.0; detail: This absolute endpoint equals 27.5% of gross revenue; do not add it as another movement or describe gross sales as the owner's earnings.

text.title: Reconcile $160,000 Gross Sales to $44,000 Owner Net
text.tspan: Reconcile $160,000 Gross Sales to $44,000 Owner Net

rect.title: label: Gross domain sale proceeds; value: $160,000 annual operator revenue; numeric value: 160000.0; detail: Start with completed domain sales before selling fees; do not substitute portfolio asking prices, third-party merchant volume, or escrow deposits.

label: Sold-domain acquisition basis; value: -$60,000 allocated purchase costs; numeric value: -60000.0; detail: Assign purchase prices and acquisition fees to the domains sold; unsold inventory purchases remain a separate cash-use and inventory schedule.

label: Portfolio renewals; value: -$12,000 annual carrying expense; numeric value: -12000.0; detail: Include current-period renewal charges across retained and sold inventory; remove any amounts already included in acquisition basis.

label: Selling and settlement costs; value: -$24,000 combined transaction expense; numeric value: -24000.0; detail: Assume a blended 15% of gross proceeds covering marketplace commissions and settlement charges; replace this model rate with actual venue invoices.

label: Other operating expense; value: -$20,000 annual operating budget; numeric value: -20000.0; detail: Budget contractor support, research tools, outreach, and administration at approximately $1,667 monthly; exclude renewals and transaction fees counted above.

label: Annual owner net profit; value: $44,000 retained operating result; numeric value: 44000.0; detail: This absolute endpoint equals 27.5% of gross revenue; do not add it as another movement or describe gross sales as the owner's earnings.

text.title: Assumptions: The canonical Base Case fixes gross revenue at $160,000 and annual owner net profit at $44,000. The four expense buckets below are an illustrative allocation of the required $116,000 total cost, not additional scorecard facts. Intermediate bars are signed deductions; the final bar is an absolute total.
